messages:
mia (PM): Quick sync — we need a decision on an "escape hatch" for structured-output enforcement. Customers want strict JSON but some use cases need graceful acceptance + auto-repair. Proposal below.
omar (Eng): +1 on having a clear knob. current options are messy (client side hacks).
sasha (ML): We should avoid silent data loss. If we allow best-effort, we need a confidence signal for downstream.
kevin (DevEx): Thinking API surface: add param `output_mode` with values: `strict` (fail), `best_effort` (try best), `repair` (attempt to fix then return original text & repairs). Also `max_retries`. Example: 
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-xxl",
  "input": "Generate product JSON for user profile...",
  "output_mode": "repair",
  "json_schema": "<schema-id>",
  "max_retries": 2
}
```
kevin (DevEx): The runtime can return `repair_actions` and `validation_errors` fields so apps can decide.
anna (QA): Launch criteria we should require: 1) repair success rate >= 85% on our corpus 2) zero silent-corrections (always return validation_errors when not strict) 3) <200ms median extra latency for repair flow.
sasha (ML): For repair we can run a constrained decoding pass plus a targeted grammar-based sanitizer. We'll add a small eval harness.
leo (Support): Customers asked for an "opt-out" header so platform teams can enforce strict at the gateway. Also request audit logs for repairs.
omar (Eng): Implementation notes: runtime will attempt validation after decode; if fails and output_mode!=strict and retries left => call repair worker with KV cache reuse to save cost. Fallback policy: if repair fails, return original plus `validation_errors` and `fallback: true`.
kevin (DevEx): UX ideas: in Console show per-request `validation_status`, `repairs`, and `repair_cost_estimate`. Expose a toggle for Console-level default output_mode.
mia (PM): Customer tradeoffs: strict gives clear contract but increases failed calls; best_effort reduces errors but can surprise customers if not signaled. We should default to `best_effort` but surface strong telemetry. Thoughts?
sasha (ML): Defaulting to `best_effort` is pragmatic, but require `validation_errors` to be emitted (empty list when ok). That prevents silent acceptance.
anna (QA): Metrics to track pre-launch: repair_attempt_rate, repair_success_rate, post-repair-accuracy (schema conformance + semantic checks), percent_requests_with_fallback. Target thresholds for GA: repair_success_rate >= 85%, post-repair-accuracy >= 95%, fallback < 2%.
leo (Support): For enterprise we should add a policy to force `strict` on dedicated/private deployments (config in Console + API header).
omar (Eng): Rough rollout plan: alpha on devex + two partners for 2 weeks -> gather repair logs and edge cases -> iterate. Can ship API flag behind feature-flag.
mia (PM): Action items: Omar to draft runtime PR + retry logic (owner), Sasha to build eval dataset and run initial metrics, Kevin to spec Console panels + SDK changes, Anna to write tests and acceptance criteria, Leo to document support guidance.
kevin (DevEx): SDK change: add `output_mode` default to `best_effort` and include `validation_errors`/`repair_actions` on response object.
omar (Eng): We'll also add a per-model quantized repair profile to reduce compute.
sasha (ML): Edge case: tool-calling flows — if tool expects strict JSON, then the router should enforce strict or transform the tool input based on `validation_errors`. Need to sync with integrations.
mia (PM): Quick poll — do we agree on API and launch criteria? react with :+1: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.
(20s later)
kevin (DevEx): :+1:
sasha (ML): :+1:
anna (QA): :+1:
leo (Support): :+1: I want the audit logs in the first rollout.
omar (Eng): :+1: will include minimal audit fields.
mia (PM): Great — I'll add to roadmap and prep partner alpha outreach.
deploy-bot: Deployment started for feature-flag `structured-output-repair` on staging.
